summary: Brookfield Wealth Solutions Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a management information circular for a court-approved plan of arrangement to simplify corporate structure with Brookfield Corporation, combining into one publicly traded company, Brookfield Corporation Ltd. The transaction requires shareholder approval from both entities. No specific price per share, premium, or consideration terms are stated in this excerpt. The board recommends the transaction; advisors are not named. The deal involves a structural merger via plan of arrangement, pending regulatory and shareholder approvals. Watch for shareholder vote outcome and court sanction; risk-arb focuses on approval likelihood and timing.
